# is-binary-path [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-binary-path.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-binary-path)

> Check if a filepath is a binary file


## Install

```
$ npm install --save is-binary-path
```


## Usage

```js
var isBinaryPath = require('is-binary-path');

isBinaryPath('src/unicorn.png');
//=> true

isBinaryPath('src/unicorn.txt');
//=> false
```


## Related

- [`binary-extensions`](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/binary-extensions) - List of binary file extensions
- [`is-text-path`](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-text-path) - Check if a filepath is a text file
